  val registry = readRepoFile("/tmp/gh-aw/agent/plan-tools.md")
  val executionPlan = compute("Build a registry-grounded plan for reading gather evidence, grading findings, writing evidence, and publishing noop", registry)
  val taskContext = readRepoFile("/tmp/gh-aw/task-context.json")
  val evidence = compute("Echo gather scope and verdict exactly, grade one entry per matrix cell, and include examined refs", executionPlan, taskContext)
  writeFile("/tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json", evidence)
  publish("safeoutputs.noop", "No action needed: spec-solves-issue judge evidence written; gather was out of scope with no findings to grade.")
}
